create.name: Dzogchen Ponlop Rinpoche
create.bio:
Dzogchen Ponlop Rinpoche is a Tibetan Buddhist teacher and scholar trained in both the Nyingma and Kagyu schools. He founded Nalandabodhi, an international network of Buddhist centres, and the Nitartha Institute for Higher Buddhist Studies, and he leads both as their spiritual director. Nalanda West, the contemplative centre he opened in a former church in Seattle in 2004, is Nalandabodhi's headquarters and his seat in the Americas. Through these communities he offers a path that combines study, meditation and mindful activity in daily life.

He is known for a direct, humorous and relaxed way of teaching aimed at modern, urban audiences, and for the kindness campaign #GoKind. Outside the shrine room he is a poet, photographer, calligrapher and visual artist with a love of classic rock. His books bring traditional teachings into contemporary language. Rebel Buddha and Emotional Rescue are written for readers new to Buddhism, the second focusing on how to work with strong feelings; Mind Beyond Death explains Tibetan teachings on dying and the in-between states; and Wild Awakening and Penetrating Wisdom, the latter a commentary on the Aspiration of Samantabhadra, turn to the nature of mind.

books.title: Rebel Buddha
books.author: Dzogchen Ponlop Rinpoche
books.description: His best-known book, which presents the Buddha's teaching as a path to freedom of mind for readers with no Buddhist background.

books.title: Emotional Rescue: How to Work with Your Emotions to Transform Hurt and Confusion into Energy That Empowers You
books.author: Dzogchen Ponlop
books.description: A practical guide to meeting strong emotions with awareness, drawing on Buddhist practice to work with their energy rather than be swept away by it.

books.title: Mind Beyond Death
books.author: Dzogchen Ponlop Rinpoche
books.description: A guide to what Tibetan Buddhism teaches about dying and the in-between states that follow, and how to prepare through practice in this life.

books.title: Wild Awakening
books.author: Dzogchen Ponlop Rinpoche
books.description: Teachings on recognising the nature of mind in the Tibetan traditions he holds.

books.title: Penetrating Wisdom: The Aspiration of Samantabhadra
books.author: Dzogchen Ponlop Rinpoche
books.description: A commentary on a famous Dzogchen prayer, the Aspiration of Samantabhadra, and what it teaches about awareness and confusion.
